g.text: Exact characteristic-halfspace solutions: contours and decay
Proof locators: CH15, CH25–CH31. Example dimensions: R=1.4, c=2.6, T=6, θ₀=1.8; illustrative exponents α=1/2, β=3/4.
Human source: Hörmander I, Theorem 8.6.7, printed pp. 310–311. Original receiving derivation and reproducible figure; schematic coefficients.
